note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Servers are started hidden by prepare (helper %TEMP%\mgnet\svc.ps1) and their logs are shown with Get-Content/Select-String. The API listens on 5207 (REST + SignalR, HTTP/1) and 5208 (gRPC, HTTP/2 only) from appsettings.Development.json. The CLI lives in src/ProjectRequests.Cli; terminal scenes start there. The live-board screen is a browser capture with two terminals beside it (steps).

screens.name: cli-calls
import-live
steps: Prepare already restarted the API with an empty database so ids start at 1; Web app on 5180
Browser on http://localhost:5180/live: 'SignalR: connected · watching all departments'
Terminal B (src\ProjectRequests.Cli): dotnet run -- import sample-import.csv
Board gains three rows (#1 OPS, #2 IT, #3 FIN); the FIN watcher prints only 'NEW     #3 FIN Standing desks ...'
